rows.organisme: Atestarea tehnico-profesională (Ministry of Infrastructure) — registers published by IP OATUCL
rows.notes: No professional order: State certification (HG 743/2024, E_permis register). The “Lista proiectanților atestați” (31 July 2026, verified) counts 906 proiectanți across all disciplines; 312 carry architecture domains (codes A.1-4/3a-d/34.2.x) — count carried out on the nominal PDF. The title is not protected; what is protected is the right to sign and to verify. A “Specialiști atestați” dataset is flagged on dataset.gov.md (id 19433), the portal being unreachable at the time of testing. Moldova is ABSENT from the list of UIA sections (verified) despite statements to the contrary; UARM ~300 members (secondary sources). Direct count of the Lista as at 31 July 2026, carried out on 5 August 2026: 308 certified in the “Arhitectură” domain (criterion: letters A.*, or domain 3 of HG 207/2022, or codes 34.2.* of HG 743/2024-499/2025) out of 906 designers across all disciplines; 329 if urban planning/spatial planning is included; nr. crt. continuous 1..906.

rows.organisme: State qualification attestation (Ministry of Architecture and Construction), operated by РУП “Белстройцентр”
rows.notes: An Аттестат квалификационный is required for regulated functions (Code of architectural and town-planning activity, 17.07.2023, ch. 8); examinations and register held by Belstroycentr. A nominal register is said to exist online (rcuk.bsc.by/att_search) but the WHOLE .by domain remained unreachable from this network (403/DNS) — URLs not verified and therefore not delivered; no aggregate headcount found. BSA (founded 1935, UIA member): 720 members (bsa.by snippet) to “more than 1,000” (Russian Wikipedia) — discrepancy not settled.

rows.organisme: No professional order and no compulsory register (deregulated profession) — State certification being introduced

alternatives.nom: Union of Architects of Georgia (საქართველოს არქიტექტორთა კავშირი)

rows.notes: FINDING (verified on matsne.gov.ge, doc 32506, law “on architectural activity” amended 9 June 2026): art. 4 — only a certified architect will be able to sign off a project, transitional exemption until 20 December 2026; certifying body not yet designated — to be re-verified in early 2027. At present: no licence, no chamber, no register. Creative union (1931, 722 members, UIA section) with no verified official site. Pitfall: “Georgia architect license” returns the US state.

rows.organisme: Urban Development Committee (Քաղաքաշինության կոմիտե) — licences for organisations + certification of responsible specialists

alternatives.nom: Union of Architects of Armenia (Հայաստանի ճարտարապետների միություն)

rows.notes: DOWNLOADABLE nominal State register (XLSX verified, 28 June 2026): 3,146 certificates for 2,193 individuals — BUT group 01 (town-planning documents) expressly EXCLUDES the architectural parts; architecture appears only under expert appraisal (code 02.01: 16 certificates). It is impossible to count design architects — headcount left null despite good-quality open data. Union of Architects: 643 members (year unknown), UIA member; uaa.am offline. Pitfall: do not present the 2,193 certificate holders as architects.

rows.organisme: No individual register — activity licences issued to legal entities (State Committee for Urban Planning and Architecture)
rows.notes: The State Committee (arxkom.gov.az, verified) keeps NO register of architects (master plans, permits, register of BUILDINGS). Licences to legal entities (2016 law); e-qanun.az and icaze.gov.az unreachable at the time of testing. The Union of memarlar (1934/36, UIA section, uaa.az verified) does not publish its headcount. Any estimate would be invented — no public nominal data.
